papers.title: Fungal glycans boost mRNA-based vaccines
papers.summary: mRNA-based vaccines saved millions of lives during the COVID-19 pandemic, but they require frequent boosting and periodic updates to match emerging virus strains. We demonstrate that fungal glycans can function as adjuvants for mRNA-based vaccines, expanding the durability and breath of protection against several virus strains. These findings support the development of a new generation of RNA-based vaccines with improved performance

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 基于mRNA的疫苗在COVID-19大流行期间拯救了数百万人的生命，但它们需要定期进行加强接种，并根据新出现的病毒株进行更新。
llm_highlights_zh: 我们证明了真菌糖链可以作为基于mRNA的疫苗的辅助剂，从而增强这些疫苗对多种病毒株的防护效果，并延长其保护作用持续时间。
这些研究结果为开发性能更优的新一代RNA疫苗提供了有力支持。

all_papers.title: Fungal glycans boost mRNA-based vaccines
all_papers.summary: mRNA-based vaccines saved millions of lives during the COVID-19 pandemic, but they require frequent boosting and periodic updates to match emerging virus strains. We demonstrate that fungal glycans can function as adjuvants for mRNA-based vaccines, expanding the durability and breath of protection against several virus strains. These findings support the development of a new generation of RNA-based vaccines with improved performance
all_papers.llm_title_zh: 真菌糖链可增强基于mRNA的疫苗的效果。
all_papers.llm_title_bilingual: 真菌糖链可增强基于mRNA的疫苗的效果。 / Fungal glycans boost mRNA-based vaccines
all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 基于mRNA的疫苗在COVID-19大流行期间拯救了数百万人的生命，但它们需要定期进行加强接种，并根据新出现的病毒株进行更新。
llm_highlights_zh: 我们证明了真菌糖链可以作为基于mRNA的疫苗的辅助剂，从而增强这些疫苗对多种病毒株的防护效果，并延长其保护作用持续时间。
这些研究结果为开发性能更优的新一代RNA疫苗提供了有力支持。
真菌糖链可增强基于mRNA的疫苗的效果。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 在COVID-19大流行期间，基于mRNA的疫苗挽救了数百万人的生命，但它们需要定期接种加强针，并根据新出现的病毒株进行更新。我们的研究表明，真菌糖链可以作为这些疫苗的佐剂，从而显著提升其效力并延长对多种病毒株的保护作用。这些发现为开发性能更优的新一代RNA疫苗提供了重要依据。

all_papers.title: AreTomoLive: automated reconstruction of comprehensively corrected and denoised cryo-electron tomograms in real time and at high throughput
all_papers.summary: AreTomoLive is an accelerated preprocessing pipeline for cryo-electron tomography that streamlines tomographic alignment, reconstruction and contrast enhancement. This pipeline prioritizes automation and throughput to deliver comprehensively corrected and denoised tomograms, including during data collection at scale

all_papers.primary_summary_zh: AreTomoLive是一种专为冷冻电子断层扫描设计的加速预处理流程，它能够显著简化断层图像的对齐、重建及对比度增强过程。该流程注重自动化操作与数据处理效率，从而确保最终生成的断层图像经过全面校正且去除了噪声，这一流程同样适用于大规模数据采集场景。

all_papers.title: Adding chemical identity to cryo-electron microscopy
all_papers.summary: A correlative workflow combining cryo-electron microscopy and cryo-electron tomography with secondary ion mass spectrometry generates spatially registered chemical maps from the same vitrified sample, directly linking ultrastructural information with molecular composition. This advance opens new avenues for identifying where drugs, pollutants and signaling molecules reside within cells at nanoscale resolution
